CSCustomAttributeKey.doc: A key associated with a custom attribute for a searchable item.

CSImportExtension.doc: An object that provides searchable attributes for file types that the app supports.

CSLocalizedString.doc: An object that displays localized text in search results related to your app.

CSSearchQueryContext.doc: The behavior configuration to use for a search query.

keyName.doc: The name of the custom attribute key.

searchable.doc: A Boolean value that indicates if the custom attribute can be specified as a search term.

searchableByDefault.doc: A Boolean value that indicates if the custom attribute should be searchable by default.

unique.doc: A Boolean value that indicates if duplicate custom attribute values should be treated as the same value to save storage space.

contactIdentifier.doc: The identifier for the contact associated with the person.

displayName.doc: A display name for the person.

handleIdentifier.doc: A key that identifies the type of contact property represented by the person object’s handle.

handles.doc: An array of contact handles related to the person.

cancelled.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the current query is no longer running.

completionHandler.doc: The block to execute when the query finishes delivering all results.

foundItemCount.doc: The number of matching items found for the given query string.

protectionClasses.doc: The protection types of the indexes you want to search.

results.doc: The results that match the current query string.

CSSearchQuerySourceOptions.doc: The query source options to allow or deny Mail messages in the search.

fetchAttributes.doc: The attributes the system fetches for the searchable items.

filterQueries.doc: The query string used to filter the results.

keyboardLanguage.doc: The language used for the query.

sourceOptions.doc: The query source options to allow or deny Mail messages in the search.

indexDelegate.doc: The delegate object that can handle index-management tasks.

attributeSet.doc: The set of attributes that contain metadata associated with the item in a CSSearchableItemAttributeSet object.

domainIdentifier.doc: An optional identifier that represents the domain or owner of the item.

init(appEntity:priority:).doc: Initializes a new searchable item with the relevant fields populated from the provided app entity.

isUpdate.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to treat the item as an update instead of a new item.

relatedAppEntityIdentifier.doc: The identifier of the related indexed entity for this searchable item.

uniqueIdentifier.doc: The value that uniquely identifies the searchable item within your app.

updateListenerOptions.doc: The types of notifications to request from Spotlight.

EXIFGPSVersion.doc: The version of GPS Info IFD header that was used to generate the metadata for the image.

EXIFVersion.doc: The version of the EXIF header that was used to generate the metadata for the image.

GPSDOP.doc: The GPS dilution of precision value.

GPSDateStamp.doc: The date and time related to the GPS value.

GPSDestBearing.doc: The bearing to the destination point.

GPSDestDistance.doc: The distance to the destination point.

GPSDestLatitude.doc: The latitude of the destination point.

GPSDestLongitude.doc: The longitude of the destination point.

GPSDifferental.doc: The differential correction applied to the GPS receiver.

GPSMapDatum.doc: The geodetic data that the GPS receiver uses.

GPSMeasureMode.doc: The measurement precision mode in use by the GPS receiver.

GPSProcessingMethod.doc: The location finding method that the GPS receiver uses.

GPSStatus.doc: The status of the GPS receiver.

GPSTrack.doc: The direction of travel of the item in degrees from true north.

HTMLContentData.doc: The HTML content of the document encoded as an NSData object representing a UTF-8 encoded string.

ISOSpeed.doc: The ISO speed setting at the time the camera captured the image.

URL.doc: The URL associated with the media.

accountHandles.doc: An array of the canonical handles for the account with which the message is associated.

accountIdentifier.doc: The unique identifier for the account with which the message is associated, if any.

acquisitionMake.doc: The manufacturer of the device that captured the image.

acquisitionModel.doc: The model of the device that captured the image.

actionIdentifiers.doc: The identifiers that specify custom actions the app supports for the item.

addedDate.doc: The date on which the item was moved into its current location.

additionalRecipients.doc: An array of CSPerson objects representing the content of the Cc: field in an email message.

album.doc: The title for a collection of audio media.

allDay.doc: A value that indicates if the event covers an entire day.

alternateNames.doc: An array of localized strings that represent alternate display names for the item.

altitude.doc: The altitude of the item in meters above sea level, expressed using the WGS84 datum.

aperture.doc: The size of the lens aperture at the time the camera captured the image, as a log-scale APEX value.

artist.doc: The artist associated with the media.

associateAppEntity(_:priority:).doc: Associates the specified app entity with this attribute set.

audiences.doc: A class of entity for which the item is intended or useful.

audioBitRate.doc: The audio bit rate of the media.

audioChannelCount.doc: The number of channels in the audio data that the file contains.

audioEncodingApplication.doc: The name of the application that encoded the data the audio file contains.

audioSampleRate.doc: The sample rate of the audio data the file contains, as a float value representing Hz (audio frames per second), such as 44100.0 or 22254.54.

audioTrackNumber.doc: The track number of a song or audio composition when part of an album.

authorAddresses.doc: An array of addresses associated with the author of the message.

authorEmailAddresses.doc: An array of email addresses associated with the author of the message.

authorNames.doc: An array of names representing the authors who have worked on the message.

authors.doc: An array of CSPerson objects representing the content of the From: field in an item.

bitsPerSample.doc: The number of bits per sample.

cameraOwner.doc: The owner of the camera that captured the image.

city.doc: The city of the item’s origin according to guidelines that the provider establishes.

codecs.doc: The codecs used to encode/decode the media.

colorSpace.doc: The color space model the image uses, such as RGB, CMYK, YUV, or YCbCr.

comment.doc: A comment related to the media file.

completionDate.doc: The date on which the item was completed.

composer.doc: The composer of the song or audio composition that the audio file contains.

contactKeywords.doc: A list of contacts who are associated with the content in some way, not including the author.

containerDisplayName.doc: A localized string that specifies the name of a container to which the item belongs, suitable to display in the user interface.

containerIdentifier.doc: The identifier of the container to which the item belongs.

containerOrder.doc: The order of the item within the container.

containerTitle.doc: The title of the container to which the item belongs.

contentCreationDate.doc: The creation date of an edited or optimized version of the song or composition.

contentDescription.doc: A description of the item’s content.

contentModificationDate.doc: The date on which the contents of the file was last modified.

contentRating.doc: A value that indicates if the media contains explicit content.

contentSources.doc: An array of sources from which the media was obtained.

contentType.doc: The uniform type identifier (UTI) of the item.

contentTypeTree.doc: An attribute type that identifies a custom hierarchy of types to describe the attributes of your item.

contentURL.doc: The file URL of the content to index.

contributors.doc: A list of people, organizations, or services that made contributions to the media content.

copyright.doc: The copyright date of the content.

country.doc: The full, publishable name of the country or region in which the intellectual property of the item was created, according to guidelines the provider establishes.

coverage.doc: A list of descriptors that specify the extent or scope of the media.

creator.doc: The name of the app that created the content.

darkThumbnailURL.doc: The local file URL of the thumbnail image for the item when Dark Mode is active.

deliveryType.doc: The delivery type of the file.

director.doc: The name of the director of the media (for example, a movie director).

displayName.doc: A localized string that contains the name of the item, suitable to display in the user interface.

domainIdentifier.doc: An identifier that represents the domain or owner of the item.

downloadedDate.doc: The most recent date on which the file was downloaded or received.

dueDate.doc: The date on which the item is due.

duration.doc: The duration (if appropriate) of the content of the file, in seconds.

editors.doc: A list of editors who have worked on the file.

emailAddresses.doc: An array of email addresses associated with the message.

emailHeaders.doc: A dictionary that contains all the headers of the message.

encodingApplications.doc: The name of the apps that converted the original content into a PDF stream.

endDate.doc: The end date for the item.

exposureMode.doc: The mode the camera used for the exposure of the image.

exposureProgram.doc: The class of the program the camera used to set exposure when capturing the image.

exposureTime.doc: The time that the lens was open during exposure, in seconds.

exposureTimeString.doc: The time that the lens was open during exposure, in a string, such as “1/250 seconds”.

fNumber.doc: The focal length of the lens, divided by the diameter of the aperture when the camera captured the image.

fileSize.doc: The size of the document file.

flashOn.doc: A value that indicates if the camera used a flash to capture the image.

focalLength.doc: The actual focal length of the lens, in millimeters.

focalLength35mm.doc: A value that indicates if the focal length is 35mm.

fontNames.doc: An array of font names the document uses.

fullyFormattedAddress.doc: The fully formatted address of the item, received from MapKit.

generalMIDISequence.doc: A value that indicates whether the MIDI sequence the file contains is set up for use with a general MIDI device.

hasAlphaChannel.doc: Indicates if the image file has an alpha channel.

headline.doc: A publishable string that provides a synopsis of the contents of the item.

hiddenAdditionalRecipients.doc: An array of CSPerson objects representing the content of the Bcc: field in an email message.

identifier.doc: A formal identifier that references the document the item represents.

imageDirection.doc: The direction of the item’s image in degrees from true north.

importantDates.doc: An array of important dates associated with the item.

instantMessageAddresses.doc: An array of instant message addresses for the message.

instructions.doc: Instructions that concern the use of the item, such as an embargo or warning.

isPriority.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the mail or messages content represents a prioritized item.

keySignature.doc: The musical key of the song or audio composition that the file contains, such as C, Dm, or F#m.

keywords.doc: An array of keywords associated with the item, such as work, birthday, important, and so on.

kind.doc: A description of the kind of document the item represents.

languages.doc: A list of the included languages for the intellectual content of the media.

lastUsedDate.doc: The date on which the file was last used.

latitude.doc: The latitude of the item, in degrees north of the equator, expressed using the WGS84 datum.

layerNames.doc: An array that contains the names of the various layers in the file.

lensModel.doc: The model of the lens that captured the image.

likelyJunk.doc: A value that indicates if the message is likely to be considered junk.

local.doc: A value that indicates if the media is local.

longitude.doc: The longitude of the item, in degrees east of the prime meridian, expressed using the WGS84 datum.

lyricist.doc: The lyricist or text writer for the song or audio composition that the file contains.

mailboxIdentifiers.doc: An array of mailbox identifiers associated with the message.

maxAperture.doc: The smallest F number of the lens.

mediaTypes.doc: The media types present in the content.

metadataModificationDate.doc: The date on which the last metadata attribute was changed.

musicalGenre.doc: The musical genre of the song or audio composition that the file contains, such as jazz, pop, rock, or classical.

musicalInstrumentCategory.doc: The category of the instrument associated with the audio file.

musicalInstrumentName.doc: The name of an instrument within the context of an instrument category.

namedLocation.doc: The name of the location or point of interest associated with the item.

organizations.doc: A list of companies or organizations that created the content.

originalFormat.doc: The original format of the media.

originalSource.doc: The original source of the media.

pageCount.doc: The number of pages in the document.

pageHeight.doc: The height of the document page, in points (72 points per inch).

pageWidth.doc: The width of the document page, in points (72 points per inch).

participants.doc: A list of people who are visible in an image or movie or written about in a document.

path.doc: The complete path to the item.

performers.doc: A list of performers in the media.

phoneNumbers.doc: An array of phone numbers associated with the message.

pixelCount.doc: The total number of pixels in the image.

pixelHeight.doc: The height of the item, such as image or video frame height, in pixels.

pixelWidth.doc: The width of the item, such as image or video frame width, in pixels.

playCount.doc: A user-supplied play count for the media.

postalCode.doc: The postal code for the item according to guidelines the provider establishes.

primaryRecipients.doc: An array of CSPerson objects representing the content of the To: field in an email message.

profileName.doc: The name of the color profile the camera used for the image.

projects.doc: A list of projects of which this file is a part.

providerDataTypeIdentifiers.doc: An array of type identifiers that correspond to data types your delegate object can provide.

providerFileTypeIdentifiers.doc: An array of type identifiers that correspond to file types your delegate object can provide.

providerInPlaceFileTypeIdentifiers.doc: An array of type identifiers that correspond to in-place file types your delegate object can provide.

publishers.doc: A list of people, organizations, services, or other entities responsible for making the media available.

rankingHint.doc: A number that indicates the relative importance of the item among other items from the app.

rating.doc: The user-supplied rating of the media.

recipientAddresses.doc: An array of addresses associated with the recipients of the message.

recipientEmailAddresses.doc: An array of email addresses associated with the recipient.

recipientNames.doc: An array of names representing the recipients of this message.

recordingDate.doc: The recording date of the song or composition.

redEyeOn.doc: A value that indicates if the camera used red-eye reduction when capturing the image.

relatedUniqueIdentifier.doc: The unique identifier for the item to which the activity is related.

resolutionHeightDPI.doc: The resolution height of the image, in DPI.

resolutionWidthDPI.doc: The resolution width of the image, in DPI.

rights.doc: A link to information about the rights held in and over the media.

role.doc: Indicates the role of the content creator.

securityMethod.doc: The security method (a type of encryption) that protects the document file.

sharedItemContentType.doc: The file type of the item to enable the user to share items from Spotlight.

speed.doc: The speed of the item, in kilometers per hour.

startDate.doc: The start date for the item.

stateOrProvince.doc: The province or state of origin according to guidelines the provider establishes.

streamable.doc: A value that indicates if the content is prepared for streaming.

subThoroughfare.doc: The sublocation, such as a street number, for the item according to guidelines the provider establishes.

supportsNavigation.doc: A value that indicates whether the item contains information sufficient to provide navigation to the location it represents.

supportsPhoneCall.doc: A value that indicates whether the item contains information sufficient to allow a phone call to a number associated with the item.

tempo.doc: The tempo of the music that the audio file contains, in beats per minute.

textContent.doc: The textual content of the message.

textContentSummary.doc: A string that presents the Apple Intelligence summarization of the item.

thoroughfare.doc: The thoroughfare, such as a street name, associated with the location for the item according to guidelines the provider establishes.

thumbnailData.doc: Image data that represents the thumbnail of the item.

thumbnailURL.doc: The local file URL of the thumbnail image for the item.

timeSignature.doc: The time signature of the musical composition that the audio or MIDI file contains, in a string, such as “4/4” or “7/8”.

totalBitRate.doc: The total bit rate of the media, combining audio and video.

transcribedTextContent.doc: A string that represents the text the system transcribed.

userCreated.doc: A value that indicates the user created the item.

userCurated.doc: A value that indicates the user selected the item.

userOwned.doc: A value that indicates the user purchased or owns the item.

version.doc: A version string associated with the file.

videoBitRate.doc: The video bit rate of the media.

weakRelatedUniqueIdentifier.doc: The unique identifier for the item to which the activity is related, but not linked.

whiteBalance.doc: The white balance setting when the camera captured the image.

localizedAttributedSuggestion.doc: An attributed string for the localized suggestion.
